svg.title: SigilChain architecture
svg.desc: Four stages: sender encrypts once, recipient device decrypts and watermarks and signs, validator network commits by quorum before release, trace console recovers the watermark and verifies the evidence.
svg.text: end-to-end architecture: encrypt once, mark at decryption, commit before release, verify independently
binds hash of the marked PDF
quorum not reached, no copy exists
Private keys stay on the device
ML-KEM-768 · ML-DSA-65 · AES-256-GCM · etcd Raft · SHA-256 hash chain
No commit, no copy. Weak evidence is reported as inconclusive; the system never names the closest recipient.
